title: Python install pulls from an additional index
description: requirements.txt declares an `--extra-index-url` that adds a second index to every resolution. The installer searches both indexes for the best match, so a package published to the extra index can win over the reviewed one.
remediation: Use one trusted index, or pin every requirement with hashes so a substitute cannot match.
limitation: It matches an `--extra-index-url` that adds a second index to every resolution in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
